div.p: do boí ac Find’, ar Oissīn, ‘.i. Ūaine ingen Moduirnd 7 tuc Find éra tochmairc furri ara immat d’ilrachtaib a téiged sí ūair ní raibe bethadach nā téighed sí i richt 7 tāngadur ind ḟīann laithe n-ǣn arin carnn ōs chind in locha sin 7 tāinic in fīad amach arin loch 7 do lenamar-ne arin loch hé 7 do ēirig in pēist dūind 7 do marb cét cú 7 cét fer accaind 7 is annsin do īarfaig Caīlti do Ḟind: “in lind tuitfis in pēist 7 mas ed co cuirmis rīa 7 co ṅdīghlamais ar muintir furri?”.
7 tuc Find a ordain fā déd fis 7 ro faillsiged fír fāistine dó 7 a-dubairt in laīd:
bid bind guth cluic ann biaid tan
ar dā cét dēg sét saíre
iss é is áille at-connarcc rīam
iss é lán don leith anīar.
bid adhnacht rīg cend a cenn

Ní héitir a indissin nā a aisnēis neoch ro indissetar do dēnam dóib féin do mōrgnīmaib gaile 7 gaiscid 7 do maithib na féine re tǽb dindsenchais cach cnuic 7 cach ḟeraind ro ḟīarfaigetar fir Ēirenn díb.

IS annsin tāinic Trénbrugaid mac Trēin .i. flaithbriugaid cétach comramach do ríg Ēirenn .i. trī .l. fer mōr ina ḟarrad 7 faíderān fírgorm im cach fer díb 7 lēinti lígdha lángela umpu 7 trī .l. gaballorg ina lámaib. 7 ro bennaigedur do rí Ēirenn 7 fregrais in rí īat.
‘Atá fleg mōr acaind duit, a ríg’, ar sīat, ‘.i. deich fichid dabach do midh 7 deich .xx. dabach do chuirm glain gabāltaig cona dǣithin do bíadaib ilarda écsamlaib leó’.
7 tucsat in bīad 7 in lind leó don ríg.
ET do ḟīarfaig rí Ēirenn d’Oissīn: ‘in a n-ǣntech re maithib Ēirenn rachaisi nó in tech óil 7 aībniusa ar leith bes accaib?’.

‘Ar cuit bíd 7 lenda duind
ar leith’, arsi Oissīn, ‘ūair ní lucht comdíne nā comaimsire dūind na daíne anois’.
‘Dā nǣnbur’, ar Oissīn, ‘.i. nōnbur dam-sa 7 nǣnbur dom’ chomalta do Chaīlti’.
‘Fiche dabach cona ndǣithin bíd dōib’, ar rí Ēirenn.
‘Maith, a ríg’, ar Caīlti, ‘nā cutrumaig-siu sind do bíud nó do lind chaīchi. Ūair in tan do-berthea deich ndabcha damh-sa .xxx. dabach <...>chóir d’Oissīn’.
7 ro chaithedur ind adhaig sin co subach sobrónach co tāinic lā cona lānṡoillsi gan uresbaid bíd na dighi forro.

Ocus do cuired a phupall tar rīg Ēirenn issin tulaig thonnglais in lá sin 7 nír’ léiced ach rídamna issin pupaill 7 tāinic Pātraic cona chléirchib issin darna leth don phupaill 7 nír léiced acht esgob 7 sacart 7 mac ochta rīg nime 7 talman issin leith i rroibe Pātraic. Suidhis Oissīn i fīadnaissi Pátraic 7 Caīlti i fīadnaisi rīg Ēirenn.
‘Cīa accaib as sine’, ar rí Ēirenn.
‘Missi’, ar Caīlti, ‘ūair .x. mblīadna .xx. dobo tṡlān dam in tan rucad Oissīn 7 .uíí. mblīadna déc dó am leapaid-sea 7 as mo thigh ro gab fēind 7 foirind’.
IS annsin do ḟīarfaig rīg Ēirenn: ‘cá lín do rígaib ēirenn leis a tucad ferann don ḟēind?’.

Fregrais Caīlti sin ōr do boí a ḟis aice .i. ‘rīg ro gabusdur ēirinn .i. Feradach Fechtnach 7 da bādur dā mac aici .i. Tūathal 7 Fīacha a n-anmanna 7 fūair Feradhach bás 7 do roindset a dā mac éire eturru .i. seóit 7 maīne 7 indmusa 7 būara 7 bóthāinte, a failgi 7 a fornasca, a ndūinte 7 a ndingna 7 a ndegbailti don darna fer. A halla 7 a hindbera, a mes 7 a mōrthorad 7 a héicned āille eochurbreca 7 a fīadach don ḟir aile’.
‘Cāit a ndernnsat in roind sin?’, ar rí ēirenn.
‘Immon cnoc so ara fuilmid inar suidhe do roindset dā mac rīg ēirenn eturru’.
‘Ní samlaithi in dā roind sin’, ar maithe fer nēirenn.
‘Cé díb roind bod ferr lib-si’, ar Oissīn, ‘.i. a fleda 7 a tighi 7 a maithius archena issin darna roind dīb a feda 7 a fāssaigi, a selg 7 a fīadach issin roind aili?’.
‘In roind ba messa díb’, ar Caīlti, ‘iss í ba ferr linde’.
‘Ráid 7 indis a ḟírinde siūt, a Chaīlti’, ar Oissīn. Oissīn cecinit:
do cach crīch fil um Uisnech.’
Cīa ro scar re gillacht chon?
Meadbair lem in ní dīa fuil
ó ro lessaig Fīacha in féind
Ruc do roga in mac ba só
a fleda, a tairgthi, a tighi
cor’ thuit lé Mál in maclaith
bá tásc rígh, rūamnus a gail
bás in ríg ind aídchi sin.
Luid Fīacha a Temraig co rath
a deich do Garad nár gann
Cas mac Cannáin, crūaid a neim
deich ṁblīadna dōib, līth nach gann
Ro gab Cumall, crūaid a neim
trīcha lǣch, ba mōr a ngal
im Daigri, im Goll, im Garad.
Goll mōr, ba mílid i cath
deich ṁblīadna dó, līth nār gann
Ar sin ro gab int eó ōir
Secht rí déc is deimin lim
Ba díb Bagna a Síd Bagna
Mog Ruith is Find a Formaīl.
Cūicer is gaīthe um cēill ngrind
ro boí a n-ǣntig a nĒirinn
in cheist do-nīth Find na fled
Lugh mac Céin meic Cáinte anall
budh ḟerr um brat imum bīad
Cú na cerda, crūaid a báig
Find is Mac Luchta ar ǣnchǽ.
Lǣch ar gairbe co ṅgnīm ṅglonn
Ni ḟetar locht ar ḟēind ḟind
dar in rí uil ōs mo chind
ní ḟuil in cuire gan cleith
Ferr a sretha nā cach sreath
ferr nā cach rīg a taīssech
mét na fer is mét a scīath
Ba ríg, bá fáid, ba fili
ar fisid ’s ar ṅdraī ’s ar fáid
ba bind lind cach ní do ráid. R.
dar in rí ḟuil ōs mo chind
ba ferr-som fōs co bá trī
cid mōr in ní rāidim-sí. Rāid.
Gu ba ṡecht do chreid in rí
in sechtmad fecht do boí ar fás
Trénmōr is ré lāim ro lǽ
mac dó Cairill fā gein Scāil
ba bínd lais cach ní ro ráid. Rāid’.

‘Adrǣ būaid 7 bennachtain, a Chaīlti’, ar Dīarmait mac Cerbaill. ‘7 cāid a filet sin 7 senchaide Ēirenn scrībthar i tamlorgaib filed 7 a slechtaib sūad 7 a mbrīatraib olloman co mbere cach a chuid lais dā crīch 7 dā ferann bodēin dā cach ní dar indis Caīlti 7 Oissīn dā mōrgnīmarthaib gaile 7 gaiscid 7 do dindṡencus Ēirenn’. 7 do-gníd amlaid sin.
IS annsin ro ḟīarfaid Find mac Fǣburdeirg mac rīg hūa Ceindselaig: ‘A Chaīlti’, ar sē, ‘crét fā dera in Giūssach ḟind naím 7 fíreōin ica hadhrad seoch cach n-inad aile issin crīch?’.

Frecrais Caīlti sin: ‘Lúgort selga d’ḟind hí’, ar sē, ‘7 in tan nā fāgdais in ḟīann a cūiged letharthach Laigen ótā Indeōin Maighi Feimin co Beind Édair a ndǣithin selga do geibdis issin Giūssaig ḟind’.
‘Maith m’anam, a Chaīlti’, ar Find mac Fǣbair, ‘crēt im n-abar áth Ferna risin n-āth atá ar lār na giūssaigi’.

Frecrais Oissīn sin: ‘Goll mac Morna ro marbustar Fernn mac Cairill ann ar foghail Chlaind Morna 7 mac rīg na ṅDēissi andes hé. 7 óclach grādha d’ḟind hē 7 arna chur fá ḟochlaitib talman tuc Find a ordain fá déd fis 7 ro faillsiged fírinde dó 7 a-dubairt: “A ḟernn meic Cairill, mo gēnar duit ro hadlaiced issinn inudh a-taí. ūair mōr do ḟindcheōlānaib ceilebartha 7 do ḟindleabraib trāth 7 do eadbairt chuirp in Choimded do-gentar ōs do chind”. 7 a-dubairt:
Bidh hé in torc trén tulcháinim
‘IS maith ām ro indissis’, ar Find mac Fǣbair, ‘7 a-tá ceist aile accum is áil lium d’ḟīarfaidi dít, a Chaīlti’.

‘Baile a-tá acainde annso í comrac in dā chóiced .i. Comar ollbuidnech na Trī nUisci, áit a comraicend Siúir 7 ḟeōir 7 Berba 7 Ros
mBrocc ainm in baile sin 7 rob āil lium-sa a ḟis d’ḟāgbāil ūait-siu cīa icá raibe in dúnad út ann’.

‘Dā óclach gráda d’ḟind mac Cumaill ro boí ann .i. Cellach Brǣnbili 7 Moling Lūath do chóiced Laigen 7 do bādur dā cét óclach 7 dā cét gilla 7 dā cét con ac cechtar dē díb 7 cid īat trī catha na féinde do tṡirthea ba terc ann dīas budh ḟerr lūth nó lāmach anāit-sium 7 do bí maith aile intib-sium mailli ris sin. ūair is ’na tigib do bīth in ḟīann re blīadna gan teirce bíd na lenda orro ris sin.
‘INgnad lind’, ar Finn mac Fǣbair, ‘uisci in baili sin in ard 7 a tṡruth ina all 7 fóirid int uisci sin cach eslāinti rē ṁbenann’.

‘INdeōssat-sa duit adbur in ratha sin’, ar Cailti: ‘IS é sin cétuisci ro bennachadur aingil Dé a nēirinn. 7 iss é uisce déidinach beós 7 tǽidiu ainm na habhann’, ar sē. ‘ET do bādur in dá óclach sin ann nó co ṅdechadur Meic Morna ar fogail ar ḟind 7 nīr’ rāthaigset aídchi ann nó cor’ gabsat Meic Morna anair 7 anīar immon ṁbaile acco 7 ro bādur teōra lá 7 teōra aídchi ac dul arin ṁbaile 7 nīr’ ḟēdatar ní dó ris sin 7 a cind in tres lá fūaradur bǣgal teined do chur ann 7 do loisced in baile leó 7 do-rigned a argain 7 ní thernó duine beó d’ḟir nā do mnaī gan a loscud ann 7 in tan tairnic leō in baili d’arggain 7 d’indrud. Tāngadur reompo tar sgairb Indbir Dubglaissi tar Berba síar ar sodain 7 iss í sin aimsir i rrāngamar-ne trī catha na féinde dochum in baile gingur’ chobair dōib-sium sin 7 suidhis Find 7 trī catha na fēinde ar faichthe in dúnaid 7 ro chaísetar co dērach dobrōnach ūair ní minic má do-rinded rīam gnīm bo doilgi leissin féind inā sin 7 tucad loingṡīthal bánóir chum na flatha Find annsin 7 ro indail a láma 7 tuc uisci ima gnūis rígda rō-ālaind 7 tuc a ordain fā déd fis 7 in tres fis is mó ro faillsiged dó rīam issin tan sin ro faillsighed dó hé 7 a-dubairt: “Ceithri faídi toghaide ticfa tar meissi a nĒirinn. 7 do rīg nime 7 talman do-génat a fāistine 7 bid annso ticfa in cethramad fer .i. Moling mac Fǣláin meic Feradaig meic ḟidgai 7 cath chuirfither re deiredh aimsire i ndĒirinn .i. cath Maigi Rath 7 Suibne Geilt tic assin chath sin is annsa baili seo muirfither hé 7 aidhlécthar 7 ben d’feraib Muman máthair in chlēirig sin 7 ní lēmat fir Muman olcc in baili seo do dēnam chaídchi 7 a-dubairt in laīd ann:
Ros ṁBrocc aniú is conair chūan
cīan gar co toirset noím ind
Moling ainm int í sa ceall.
ar ur na cairrgi is līa
forba a slūaig co Tech Moling
ó sin amach co brāth mend
geib re hanmain ḟind í bhos
IS andsin a-dubairt rí Ēirenn re Pātraic: ‘is mithig lem-sa dul co Temraig bodesta 7 in tictisi lím co Temraig?’, ar Dīarmait, ‘a ṡenorchu’.
IS annsin a-dubairt Eōchaid Lethderg rí Laigen: ‘bérat-sa Oissīn lem’, ar sē, ‘frissin ṁblīadain seo co Dún Līamna Lendchaīme ingine Dobrāin Dubthaire’.
‘Bērat-sa Caīlti lem’, ar Conall Mōr mac Nēill co Dún na ṁBārcc bothūaid risin ṁblīadain sea’.
‘Bērat-sa Pátraic lem’, ar Dīarmait mac Cerbaill, ‘co Temraig do baisted 7 do bennachad 7 d’ordugud fer nĒirenn ina cirt 7 ina rīagail fein’.

Ro scaīlset fir Ēirenn dochum a crīchi féin coro chomraicset a cind blīadna i Temraig. Corub hí accallaim na senōrach acin chartha a mullach Uisnig sin 7 cach ar chansat d’ḟis 7 d’eōlus d’feraib Ēirenn uile ó sin amach.

Dāla Chaīlti immorro ro ēirig sein reime marǣn re Conall mac Nēill co Rāith Artrach bothūaid a crīchaib Ceinēil Conaill. IS annsin do ēirgedur ingena míne macdachta mongbuide 7 meic becca bratūaine 7 óclaig in dúnaid d’ḟerthain fǣilte re Caīlti. Bādur ac ól 7 ac aíbnius re hed 7 re hathaig in cǣmlaithe sin nō cor’ ēirig grīan assa circcaill truim teintighi cor’ línastar alla 7 essa 7 indbera in talman.

INa degaid sin tāinic Conall 7 Caīlti co maithib a muintire assin baile amach 7 ro ḟīarfaid Conall: ‘cid fa tucad Rāith Artrach arin rāith seo 7 cid ima tucad Rāith Mongaid arin rāith seo thūaid 7 cid imma tucad Lis na nÉices arin lis so thes?’.
Frecais Caīlti sin: ‘Trī meic ro bādur ic Bodb Derg mac in Dagda issin brug brecsolus .i. Artrach 7 ǣd ālaind 7 ǣngus 7 tarrla imressan eturru 7 a n-athair fēin.

“Maith m’anam, a maccu”, ar Bodb Derg, “fácaid-si dam-sa Tūatha .D.D. 7 imthigid chum rīg Ēirenn, .i. chum Cormaic huí Chuind 7 a-tá adhbur ’mana cóir dáib
Tūatha .D.D. d’ḟāgbāil ūair ní fuil do crīch ac .T.D.D. a fulang féin 7 a fuil do maithius ic Artrach inmain 7 is līa d’ǣngus mac Buidb ná do .T.D.D. uile eter gilla 7 óclach 7 is līa d’ǣd álaind éices annsiūt nā do chlīaraib Ēirenn 7 Alban”.
IS annsin tāngadur trī meic Buidb co Cormac 7 fīarfaigis dīb cid do glūais īat. “Ar n-athair fēin ro ḟogair a Tūathaib .D.D. sind 7 tāngamar d’īarraid ḟeraind fortsa”.

“Do-gēbthaí-si sin”, ar Cormac, “do-bēr-sa daīb ceithri triūcha na garbthīre frisa rāiter Tír Conaill aniú 7 ro boí in mac roba tṡine díb .i. Artrach 7 bruigen .uíí. ṅdorus aici 7 mochen re cach ṅdáim. Ro boí ǣngus ilclessach í Rāith Mongāid 7 maccu rīg Ēirenn 7 Alban ac foghlaim lāmaig 7 ro boí ǣd éices a Lis na nÉices 7 clīara Ēirenn 7 Alban ina ḟarradh ann .i.x. ṁblīadna .xx. ro chaithset do ḟlaithius Chormaic huí Chuind nó co fūair bás ic Rāith Spelāin a mBregaib. Tāngadur ar cūla dorighissi co .T.D.D. 7 roba lis ballach breicderg in lis so do chnōib cǣma cendchorcra caillide 7 d’ublaib āille órbuidhe cid rāith rūad aniū”’. Caīlti cecinit:
in rāith seo co n-ilar ṁbūaid.
IN cloch-sa in taíb thūaid don lis
‘Cāit a fil in cloch, a Chaīlti’, ar Conall, ‘fó fuill int ór 7 int airget?’.
‘Ní hí in chloch as doilig d’ḟāgbāil’, ar Caīlti, ‘acht a tabairt a talmain’.

‘Ní doilig ón’, ar Conall, ‘ac ēirgi co ceithri cétaib fer n-ārmach nertmur 7 tucsat a lāma a n-ǣnḟecht chum na cloiche dā tarraing a talmain 7 ní raibi tarba issin trénfeidm ór nīr’ ḟētsat a becc di’.

‘Nī fuil fer cobartha nā tócbāla aire acaind anossa’, ar Caīlti, ac tabairt ságaid do crann a tṡleigi fuithe cor’ thóc hí dā háit 7 tuc Caīlti lám a n-inad na cloiche 7 tuc līa Find meic Cumaill as ina raibi trī .l. uinge d’airget 7 trī .l. uingi do dergór 7 trī .l. slabrad órda 7 claidim catha assa hinad.
‘Maith, a Chaīlti’, ar Conall, ‘roind na seóit’.
‘IN cloidim 7 in slabrad duit-si’, ar Caīlti, ‘7 in līa dergōir do nóem Pátraic ór iss é līa na creidme 7 irsi na ṅGǣidel hé.

IS andsin ro ḟīarfaig Conall mac Nēill do Chaīlti: ‘filet trī tulcha acaind annseo 7 nīl a fis acaind cid dīa fuilet na hanmanna a-tā orro .i. Lecht na Lǣchraide ar thulaig díb 7 Tulach in Banchuiri ar tulaig
aile díb 7 Lecht na Maccraide ainm in tres tulcha díb 7 tipra isin tul sin 7 abhann aisti amach 7 Glaissi na Fer a hainm sein’.

‘Do-gēba-su a ḟis sin ūaim-si’, ar Caīlti. ‘Ben tuc Find .i. Sadb ingen Buidb Deirg meic Dagda 7 ro tṡirestar coibchi arin flaith ar ḟind .i. leth feissi 7 leth n-ētála do thabairt dī 7 rob’ é adhbur a īarrata sin ūair is terc má do boí ó Thiprait Fáine co Garrda nIsperda ben budh ḟerr ina hí 7 ro naidmed d’ḟind hí. Ac Síd ár Femen risa rāiter Sídh Ban Find issin tan so 7 arna naidm dó do-chūaid Find ar slichtlorg Chlainde Morna ro boí ar fogail 7 ar dībeirg fair nó co toracht conici in rāith seo .i. Rāith Artrach 7 ro gabad sossad 7 longport aici annso 7 do ráid Find re Ferrdoman mac Buidhb Deirg meic in Dagda re brāthair na hingine: “is fata”, ar sē, “le Saidb ingen Buidb a-tú-sa amuigh 7 a-déra is ail 7 aithis 7 ēisleis tucusa urri re blīadain anossa 7 techta as chōir dam-sa do chur ara cenn”, ar Find, “7 cīa as chōra do chur ara cend”, ar Find. “A cethrur comaltad fein .i. Conaing 7 Cathal dā mac rīg Muman 7 in dā comalta aile .i. Cathal 7 Crimthan dā mac Cuind Cétchathaig .i. dā mac rīg Laigen 7 is īat sin cethrar as dile leis-si a nĒirinn”.
‘7 in trāth nā bīth ben i lebaid ḟind iss īat sin do bīth ina ḟarrad’, ar Caīlti.
“7 cīa ūaib, a firu rechus ann”, ar Find.
“Rachmaid-ne ann”, arsi dā mac rīg Muman .i. Conaing 7 Cathal, “ūair is ’nar crīch 7 ’nar ferann a-tá 7 iss í is dīslí 7 is dōchu lind do mnāib Ēirenn”.

7 tāngadur sin reompo ceithri cét óclach 7 ceithri cét gilla cona conaib co Síd Ban Find 7 do-chūadur issin síd solusmór anund 7 ro canad fírchaín fǣilte friu gan meing 7 gan medbail ann 7 tucad dōib nūa gacha bídh 7 sen gacha dighi 7 do bādur ann re teōra lá 7 re teōra aídchi 7 ro ráidset rīa: “is ar do chenn-sa tānacmur ó ḟind mac Cumaill”.
“Crēd fil ann”, ar inn ingen, “ach dul dā indsaigid”.

IS annsin ro gabsat in bantracht a n-eirred 7 a n-étach aistir 7 imthechta umpu cét ingen rig 7 taīssech co n-étaigib cacha datha 7 tāngadur conici in tulaig sea 7 do scuired a n-eich 7 do geltsat fér co hurchleithe talman. IS ann do gab ítu mor in ingin .i. Sadb ingen Buidb 7 in bantracht uile.
‘Ní haichnig dam uisci annso a comḟocraib’, ar Conaing mac Duib meic ǣngusa Tīrig mac rí Muman.
7 in rílīa chloichi ro boí a mullach na tulcha 7 tucsat feidm ferrda cacha fir furri cor’ chuirset assa tuinide in tromchloch 7 ro moid lochthopur grind gloinide assa hinad.

“Is feramail ro tochlad int uisci sin”, arin ingen, “7 cā ferr
ainm da ṁbīa urri nā Glaissi na Fer”.
“Dála ḟind ro geallsabair do beith annso”, arin ingen.
“Dar ar ṁbrēithir ám is andso ro geall beith 7 atá a ḟis accaind is a ndegaid Chlainde Morna do-chūaid i cōiced ollbladach Ulad”, ar sīat, “7 co Bennaib Boirchi”.
7 nī cían ro bādur ann co facadur in lūathgrinde áigh 7 irgaile atūaid cach dírge chucca i rrabadur ocht cét óclach.
“Aithnigmait”, ar Conaing, “.i. Goll mōrglonnach mac Morna fuil ann 7 dar n-indsaigne thic 7 do cuired in ingen ina carpat leō”.
7 is annsin a-dubairt Goll: “in aichintí na fir út?”.
“Aithnimaid”, ar Conān mac Morna, “.i. dā mac Duib meic ǣngusa Tírig .i. dā mac rīg Muman 7 dā ḟer gráda d’ḟind mac Cumaill īat”.

‘IS andsin tucsat muinter ḟind glūn re glīaid 7 aighed re hēislind do Goll cona muintir 7 do dibraicedar cāch a chēile díb co torcradar ceithri cét fer n-armach n-inchomlaind do Macaib Morna le muintir ḟind 7 a-torcradur-sum féin gan eladhach a mbethaid díb. Dāla in banchuire tucsat a n-aichthi re lár 7 fūaradur bás d’ūathbás ann. Conid dē atá Tulach an Banchuire’, arin tulaig seo’, ar Caīlti.

‘IS annsin tāinic Find 7 trī catha na fēine conici seo 7 at-connairc int ár 7 dāla dā mac rīg Laigen tāngadur issin tulaig 7 tucsat a mbēil re lár 7 fūaradur bás ann do cumaid a dā comalta 7 at-connairc Find sin 7 do thuitedur a airm assa lāmaib 7 ro chaīestar frassa falcmura fírtrūaga corba ḟliuch blaí ōs bruinde dó 7 ro chaíestar in ḟīann uili archena 7 a-dubairt Find: “is mairg”, ar sē, “ro soissed co tech Cuind Cétcathaig co Síd Līamna Lendchaīme 7 is olcc in scēl indestar do Dub mac ǣngusa Tírig do rīg dā chōiced Muman co Cathair tṡleibe Clāire bodes 7 co forimell tṡleibe Cúa bodes 7 is olcc in scél ro sīa co Bodb Derg co Síd Ban Find bodes .i. bás a ingine”.

7 ro ēirig Find īar sin 7 ro fēchadh int ár aicci 7 ní ḟūair Sadb 7 ro ēirgedur in ḟīann 7 do cuired na ceithri cét sin do muintir ḟind fó ḟochlaidib talman 7 is amlaid do geibthea cach fer do muintir ḟind 7 fer do Macaib Morna marb foí 7 ro scrībad a n-ainm oghaim ossa cind 7 ro ferad cluithe cáintech ann. Gurub dē atá Cnoc na Lǣchraide arin cnoc sa 7 corub dē atá Cnoc in Banchuire arin cnoc aile seo 7 Ard na Macraide arin cnoc so thūaid ó macaib rīg Laigen ro cuired fo thalmain ann. 7 iss é sin a Chonaill’, ar Caīlti in ní ro ḟīarfaigis dím 7 in ní dīa fuilet’.

IS annsin do ḟīarfaig Conall
do Chaīlti in rabadur gessa for ḟind.
‘Rob imda īat’, ar Caīlti, ‘7 ní hīat tāinic ris 7 do gab crith 7 uuromain annsin Find’, ar Caīlti asa haithli sin do chur fo talmain’. 7 a-dubairt:
dā mac Duib dā mac in rīg
bid hé in topur suthain sen
bid irdraic ac cach in scēl
meraid co tí brāth na mmeadh.
Gan imthecht maitne a Mōin Breg
gan feis adhaig ic Dún Rath
Gan feis re hingin Buidb Deirg
dh’ulcc nó do maith comall ṅglē
ár mar sin uile a n-ǣnūair.
is do bris a craide ar trī
ruc mo nert uile ar nemfní.
‘Adrǣ būaid 7 bennacht, a Chaīlti’, ar Conall, ‘is mōr in fis d’ḟácais acaind ré indissin do lucht deirid na haimsire’.

7 tāngadur issin ṁbaile anunn arsin 7 ro bādur ac ól 7 ac aībnius co trāth cumsanta dóib 7 ēirgis Caīlti arnamāirech 7 timnais ceileabrad do Conall Derg mac Nēill 7 dā muintir uile ‘7 is mithig damsa imtecht ar leith aili festa’, ar ēissim 7 téit reime sair co Loch Daim Deirg in lā sin a nDāil Araide co hairm i rrabadur dā chruimtir ūaisli do muintir Pātraic .i. Colmān Ela 7 Eōganān 7 sīat ic gabāil na cánoine caíme coimdeta 7 ic etarmolad in dūileman.

IS annsin tāngadur trī meic ecalsa do muintir na clēirech 7 do chuirset a curach amach do gabāil éisc 7 īat ac dēnam a n-uird 7 a trāth 7 at-connairc Caīlti īat 7 ro boí iccá n-ēistecht 7 a-dubairt in laíd:
Ba hannam re hó mo chind
ba minca lim ro boí than
Mall mo thurus ó Tráig Lí
‘IS andsin tāinic Colmān Ela 7 Eōganán amach 7 at-chondcadur na fir mōra 7 na coin mōra ina lāmaib.

‘IS fír’, ar Colmán, ‘is é Caīlti siūt 7 do muintir ḟind hé’, arsi Colmān, ‘7 is do muintir nóem Pātraic fōs dó 7 a thobairt isin ailēn
dár n-indsaigi na trī n-ǽnmuir a-tāit’.
7 tucad 7 do cuired īat a tech ṅdīamair ṅderrait īat 7 tucad sen cacha lenda dōib ann 7 nūa cacha bíd 7 ó thairnig dóib a proind 7 a tomultus.
Is annsin do ḟīarfaig Colmān do Chaīlti: ‘crēd fa tucad Loch Daim Deirg arin loch sin’.

Fregrais Caīlti sin: ‘Dam derg’, ar sē, ‘do boí a leslergaib na lūachra lendbrāenaigi thes 7 tēighed d’feraib 7 do chonaib na féinde fecht fá trī cacha blīadna 7 ro lensat ind ḟīann blīadain hé conici seo. Tárthamar-ne cethrar don ḟēind air .i. Dīarmaid húa Duibne 7 Mac Lugach 7 Glas mac ǣncherda Bērra 7 missi fa nessa dó ic techt dochum in locho so 7 do chaithim ar ceithri slega a n-ǣnḟecht fris 7 do-rochair lind 7 tarrasa in darna congna dē 7 tarraid Dīarmaid in congna aile 7 ruc leis co Temair Lūachra d’indsaigid ḟind 7 tuc Find bun in chongna ara traig 7 do boí in benn ūachtarac dē ara bathus 7 iss é nech ba mó don ḟēind hé 7 ro ḟacusa in congna aile a cind na hindsi seo 7 dāmad tṡolus dam is dōig co beraind eōlus dā indsaigid’. 7 a-dubairt in laíd ann:
IN loch so Loch in Daim Deirg
bid hé a ainm ó ssin amach
is mád lethan tar cach tír
ba maith ar lūth is ar cloth
‘Adráe būaid 7 bennachtain, a Chaīlti’, ar Colmān, ‘iss mōr in fis 7 in fíreōlus sin do marthain ac nech’.
‘ET decha let, a meic ecalsa’, ar Caīlti, ‘nār’ ēirig int éscca ina pupaill aérda fós’.
‘Ra ēirig’, arin mac ecalsa, ‘conid comṡolus muir 7 tír dē’.

7 is annsin ro ēirig Caílti a cúil íartharaig ind ailén 7 tuc a lām sís issin ṁbrūach 7 tuc leis anís in congna 7 léicid ar lár in tighe i rrabadur na clēirig 7 is é ba ríg Ulad in tan sin Eōchaid Fǣburderg mac Firglinde 7 ro boí í comfocus dóib-sium a Tulaig na nArm risa rāiter Mag Rath.

IS annsin do ēirig Colmān 7 Eōganān co moch .ui. meic ecalsa 7 rucsat in congna leó da thaispēnad do rīg Ulad 7 d’Ultaib archena 7 do bādur a n-ǣnach ann, deich .xx. fer n-armach ina timchell ann 7 tuc in mac ecalsa in congna i fīadnaissi rīg 7 ro thuillfidis uile in lín sin ré doinind 7 re derdan foí.
‘Cé fūair in congna’, ar rí Ulad, ‘7 cáit a frīth?’.
‘A Loch Daim Deirg fūair Caīlti hé’, ar sīat.
‘Mochin dam-sa’, ar sē, ‘da toirsed dom indsaigid ūair do ḟuicfed sencus cacha crīche 7 cacha céite 7 eterdeiliugud cacha fine accaind’.

Dála na clēirech
tāngadur ar cúl dochum a tighi 7 ro fācsat in congna ac rí Ulad.
‘Maith m’anam, a Cholmāin’, ar Caīlti, ‘créd adbur na n-ocht trāth út chum a n-eirigthi-si eter lá 7 aídchi?’.
Frecraid in nǣmchlēirech: ‘sin mōr a fáth 7 a n-adhbur’, ar Colmán, ‘.i. ocht caire atá i lenmain chuirp 7 anma cach duine 7 dílait na hocht trāth sin īat’. 7 a-dubairt Colmān in laīd:
‘Adrǣ būaid 7 bennacht, a Colmāin Ela’, ar Caīlti, ‘is maith ro ūaslaicis in cheist sin. ET cidh dam-sa’, ar Caīlti, ‘gan na hocht trātha sin do thathaighid ó ro ḟuirig Dīa mé í comaimsir riú’.
IS annsin do ḟīarfaig Colmān do Chaīlti: ‘crēd fa n-abar Tipra in Bantrachta rissin tiprait sea a cind in locha’.

7 do ḟrecair Caīlti sin: ‘Nīam ingen ǣngusa Tírig ingen rīg dā cúiced Muman luidh ar athad 7 ar élod lé hOissīn mac Find óta Dún na ṁBárc i cóiced Muman anīar conice in tiprait sea 7 ro boí Oissīn ina farrad ann cǽicis ar mís ac dēnam tṡelga 7 ḟīadaig chūicid Ulad ann 7 ticed in ingen (nó mná) .x.xx. ban cacha maitne dindlat a lám 7 a ngnūissi assinn uisci eōchargormsa.

Dála immorro ǣngusa Tírig rí Muman ro chuir co mór air a ingen do dul le hOissīn ar athad 7 ar élod 7 ro tinōiled da cúiced Muman leis .i. u. catha mōra 7 deich cét ar .xx. cét cacha catha 7 tāngadur a n-īarmōracht na féinde conici seo 7 ro boí Nīam in tan sin ac indlat acin tiprait 7 a bantracht 7 at-chonncadar na .u. catha arin tulaig ossa cind.
“Trūag sin”, arsi in ingen. “Mo gēnar do gébad bás 7 aidheg”, ar sí, “sul do chífed a oidi 7 a athair 7 a trī derbrāithri 7 maith dā cóicid Muman amlaid sin hí”.

IS annsin tuc inn ingen a gnūis re lár 7 fūair bás ann in .xxx. ban ro boī 7 ro chuir a craide ina līa ḟola tara bél amach. Conid Cnoc ind Áir ainm na tulcha ō ssin anall cos aniú 7 corub Tipra in Banchuire ainm na tiprat ó ssin illē’. 7 a-dubairt Caīlti:
Cnocc ind Áir ó ssin illē

‘At-conncadur dā cūiced Muman bás na hingine. A-dubairt in rīg: “as olcc amus ḟind 7 Oissīn 7 na féinde oraind”. 7 a-dubradur re banathlaig
dā muintir .i. Muirend ingen Muirisci dul chum Find 7 cath d’ḟūagra fair 7 do-chūaid roimpe co Rāith Chind Chon i nDāil Araide áit i rraibe ind ḟīann 7 fīarfaigis Find scela dī 7 indissig ind ethlach a toisc dó 7 a-dubairt in laīd:
“Cath ūaind ar do tṡeilb, a ḟind.
is tīachtain leis co Cenn Chon
biaid cath ar do tṡeilbse, a ḟind.
“IS andum”, ar Find, “cath d’ḟūacra orum gus aniú. ēirig amach, a Gairb Chrōnāin”, arsí Find, “7 abair rissin féind ēirgi chum in catha”.
7 tāinic Garb Crōnān amach co longphort na féinde 7 ro lēicestar trī barannglǣda Bodba ar lár longphuirt na féinde 7 ro ḟrecradur in ḟīann sin ūair do aithenset co raibe deithbir mor fair.
IS annsin ro ēirgedur ind ḟīann 7 ro cóirged cath crōda accu 7 is ann a-dubradur in ḟīann re Find: “créd adhbur in catha a ríféindig”, ar sīat, 7 ra indis Find sin.
IS annsin at-bert Fergus Fínbél filid na féinde re Find: “is cath écoir duit-siu in cath sin do thabairt do rīg Muman í folaid a ingine is marb accut”.
IS annsin ro cenglad comairle ac Find 7 ac maithib na féinde 7 at-bert Find: “cāit a fuil Smirgat ingen Abhartaig?”.
“ēirg co lūath 7 abair re hǣngus Tírech 7 re maithib Muman do-bēr-sa breth Chormaic hūa Chuind 7 Eithne Ollaman ingen Chathaīr Mōir 7 Cithrūaid meic ḟir Chǣcait”.
7 do imig frissin techtairecht sin 7 do ḟrecair rí Muman dī 7 a-dubairt: “dā tucthar cúir 7 tenta ris gēbat-sa sin”.
“7 cīa na cuir chuingi?”, ar Smirgat.
“Mac ind ḟir do-rōine olc rium .i. Osccur mac Oissīn 7 Ferrdoman mac Buidb Deirg meic in Dagda 7 Dīarmait mac Duind meic Donnchada”.

7 do ḟǽm Find sin 7 do-chūadur in ḟīann 7 rí Muman co Temraig 7 iss í breth rucsat na breithemain ro toghad ann .i. inn ingen do thōgbāil assin tulaig thogaide i rraibe 7 a cur a meidh 7 a comthrom d’ór 7 a comthrom d’airget ina héiricc do rīg muman 7 éiric ar leith in cach ingin ríg 7 taíssig a-torchair ann.
IS annsin a-dubairt Find: “cindus roindfimait ind ēiric út, a ḟīanna Ēirenn?”.
7 ro fregrad sin acco-sum: “.i. a trīan do Chlaind Baiscne 7 a dá trīan dūinde inar fīannaib”’.

‘Corub hí sin’, arsi Caīlti, ‘ǣnéiricc do roind Find rīam arin féind 7 is é sin’, ar Caīlti, ‘a chlēirig, in scēl
ro thsiris orum 7 in ní dīatá Cnoc ind Áir 7 Tipra in Bantrachta ainm na tiprat.

IS andsin ro chuir Eochaid Fǣburderg mac Firglindi .i. rí Ulad fessa 7 techta ar cenn Chaīlti ō Rāith Áini 7 do-rīachtadur sin co Loch Daim Deirg ar cenn Caīlti. Ocus ro timna Caīlti ceilebrad do Cholmān 7 d’Eōganān 7 gellsat na clēirig nem dó-sum 7 a écnairc do gabāil 7 rí nime 7 talman do guidhe fair. Dāla Chaīlti immorro do luid i carput rīg Ulad co Rāith Áini i nd-airthiur Ulad āit i rraibi Eōchaid Fǣburderg mac Firglinde rí Ulad 7 ba rí ūassal oirnide in rí sin. Ūair ní airged nech cen chóir 7 nī benad a bunadchenēl féin do neoch: IS annsin ro boí in rí trī catha cutruma i nd-ǣninad 7 is annsin do-rīacht Caīlti chuccu ocus tairlingid assin carput. 7 do-rīacht rí Ulad chucu 7 feraid fǣilti fris cona tṡlūagaib:
‘Maith m’anum, a Caīlti’, ar in rí, ‘cā ferr dūind ní dā fīarfocham āis dít nā senchus na rātha so .i. Rāith Áine?’.
‘Atá acumsa in ní dīatá sin’, ar Caīlti .i. Āine ingen Mughuirnn ingen rīg Alban anall 7 ro bādur fir Alban íca rāda rīa:
“cid taíssiu, a rīgan, gan feis re fer maith i ndAlbain nó a nĒirinn?”.

7 a-dubairt nach raibe int-ī sin fer budh dingbāla lé acht madh Find mac Cumaill amāin 7 at-clos do Ḟind sin. Is annsin a-dubairt Find re Find Fer in Champair 7 re Rōnán ríóclach, dā rīgḟéindig Alban, dul dā tochmarc ara hathair.
“Comus a fil a nĒirinn 7 a nAlbain acum-sa dī”.
“Maith, a ríḟéindig”, bar īat-summ, “dīas gráda do tṡenmuintir-si fēin lind gura mōide do chreidfed in rīgan sinde”.
“ēirig-siu 7 Mac Lugach leó, a Caīlti”, ar Find, “7 gid mōr gabthai sí foraib, do-bér-sa dī hé”.

IS annsin luid-sim reomaind in cethrar sóeróclach sin co Dún Monaid i ndAlbain 7 tucad i tech ṅdīamair ann sind 7 is annsin do-rīacht Modhurnn rí Alban is’ tech 7 a ingen arǣn ris .i. áine ingen Moduirnn 7 ro fīarfaiged ar fecht 7 ar turus dínd 7 ro indissemar ar n-aithescc.
“Ocus at-chluine siūt, a ingen”, ar in ríg, “in fer is ferr i nēirinn 7 i ndAlbain”.

7 ina degaid sin ro naidmed in ben sin d’ḟind mac Cumaill 7 cach ní do tṡir sí ar Ḟind do tabairt di 7 tāngamar-ne 7 inn ingen lind dochum ēirenn co n-ilar cacha maithius lé chum na rātha so i tāmait 7 do-rīacht Find trī catha na féinde inar coinde 7 inar comdáil ó Themair Lūachra conici in rāith sea 7 do-rigned dúnad 7 degbaile 7 grīanān ann 7 ro frithōil 7 ro ḟrestail sí trī catha na féinde re blīadain gan uresbaid bídh na lenda orra issin baile seo re tǣb ar n-áighed.
‘I cind blīadna immorro’, arsi Caīlti, ‘a-dubairt Mac Lugach re Find:
“is lór let-su do crīch 7 d’ḟerann .i. áine ingen Moduirnn”.

“Dar mo brēithir, a Meic Lugach”, ar Find, “ní
ḟetar-sa cidh do tsirfind a nēirinn nō a nAlbain acht in ní do geibit in fīann a tigh Āine”.

7 do boí in rīgan sin co cenn .ui. ṁblīadan ina degaid sin ac Find 7 do boí buidhechus fer nēirenn 7 fer nAlban urri fris sin 7 ruc dā mac d’ḟind .i. Ǣd Bec mac Find 7 Illann Fǣburderg mac Find 7 marb issi do breith Ǣda Bic meic Find’, ar Caīlti.
Dob ḟerr in ben nā cach ben
‘ET do cuired fo ḟochlaidib talman annso hí’, arse Caīlte, ‘bad a līa ossa lighi 7 ro ferad a cluithe caīntech 7 ro scrīb 7 ro tócad a hainm oghaim’.
‘Adrǣ būaid 7 bennacht, a Chaīlti’, ar rí Ulad, ‘as maith in scēl ro hindsis dūind 7 scrībtar lib in scēl út i tāmlorgaib filed 7 i llechtaib fīann’.
